assets.theme: Watercolor Pinecone and Fir Seamless Christmas Background
assets.palette: forest green, pine brown, muted red, cream, dusty sage
assets.prompt: Create a single seamless Christmas background in a handmade-shop style for craft brands, Etsy-style stationery, printable papers, and artisanal packaging. The full 16:9 image should be one continuous repeat pattern, not a board. Use hand-painted watercolor pinecones, fir sprigs, red berries, and tiny scattered stars on a soft warm cream paper ground. Ensure the pattern repeats seamlessly and shows multiple visible motifs across the whole frame. Art style: delicate watercolor with slight gouache opacity, visible brush texture, and a gentle handmade paper feel. The mood should be cozy, boutique, and handcrafted, but still commercially clear and easy to reuse. Avoid excessive visual clutter; keep the repeat balanced so buyers can overlay simple branding or crop any area. No text, no logo, no watermark, no mockup presentation, and no copied marketplace listing design.
assets.negative_prompt: text, logo, watermark, preview board, visible seam, photoreal pinecones, empty space, overprocessed texture, neon colors, branding
